sandbachFocus: Sandbach United host Eccleshall at Sandbach Community Football Centre in what proved to be a dominant performance on the day—the Ramblers secured a 2-0 victory with goals from Josh Fowles and Kyle Foley to extend their unbeaten run. Having claimed all three points, Sandbach United remain firmly at the top of the table with 22 points from 11 games, maintaining their position as the division's pacesetters.
divisionWide: Stafford Town drew 3-3 with Cheadle Heath Nomads in a thrilling encounter, with Mazurkiewicz grabbing a crucial late equalizer despite Town being reduced to ten men—they remain second on 20 points. AFC Bridgnorth suffered a setback, losing 1-0 at home to Brereton Social via an own goal, while Wolverhampton Casuals earned a convincing 3-1 away win at Shawbury United to maintain their push toward the top four. Bilston Town dominated Market Drayton Town 3-0 with an early goal and numerical advantage after Drayton's sending-off, staying in sixth place. Allscott Heath secured a comprehensive 4-1 home victory over Alsager Town with goals from James Allen, Liam Parkinson, Ben Davies, and Ethan O'Toole, climbing into contention. Barnton picked up an important 2-0 away win at Telford Town with second-half goals to extend their unbeaten league run. Wednesfield Community returned to winning ways with a 1-0 away triumph at Crewe thanks to Rio Tetsell's goal, claiming their first clean sheet of the season. New Mills fell to a 2-1 defeat at home to Dawley Town, who secured a valuable away victory with goals from the Dent brothers.
